name: Century West
label: Century West
about_prose: Century West is a City of Bend neighborhood district centered on the SW Century Drive corridor in southwest Bend, recognized by the city on July 20, 2005. It sits about 2.5 miles southwest of central Bend, between the Deschutes River corridor to the north and the Deschutes National Forest boundary to the west. Housing is predominantly single-family homes built after 2000, making it one of Bend's newer west-side districts. SW Century Drive becomes the Cascade Lakes Scenic Byway heading west, placing the neighborhood at the start of the 66-mile route toward Mt. Bachelor and the High Cascade lakes.

Families are served by Bend-La Pine Schools, with Cascade Middle School and William E. Miller Elementary as primary assigned schools and Summit High School at the high school level. OSU-Cascades, the only four-year university in Central Oregon, opened its main campus at 1500 SW Chandler Ave in 2016 just north of the district and operates an annex at 497 SW Century Drive. The 22-acre Farewell Bend Park provides river access and a trailhead to the Deschutes River Trail a mile north.

amenities.name: Farewell Bend Park
amenities.description: A 22-acre Bend Park and Recreation park at 1000 SW Reed Market Road along the Deschutes, with a lumber-mill-themed playground, climbing wall, covered picnic areas, and a Deschutes River Trail trailhead.

amenities.name: Cascade Middle School
amenities.description: A Bend-La Pine Schools grades 6-8 campus at 19619 Mountaineer Way, ranked in the top 10% of Oregon middle schools.

amenities.name: William E. Miller Elementary
amenities.description: A Bend-La Pine Schools K-5 at 300 NW Crosby Dr, ranked in the top 5% of Oregon elementary schools.

amenities.name: OSU-Cascades
amenities.description: Oregon State University's branch campus, the only four-year university in Central Oregon, with a main campus at 1500 SW Chandler Ave (opened 2016) and a Century Drive annex at 497 SW Century Drive.

amenities.name: Cascade Lakes Scenic Byway Access
amenities.description: SW Century Drive becomes the Cascade Lakes Scenic Byway at the western edge, with direct access to the Deschutes National Forest and Mt. Bachelor.
